fields.summary_ko.0: SK Hynix (SKHY +20.00%) stock rose as much as 23.7% following reports that SoftBank Group was targeting a $1 trillion acquisition.
fields.summary_ko.1: SoftBank Chairman Masayoshi Son discussed $1 trillion acquisition financing with Wall Street banks, presenting a 1.7x premium to the $57.6 billion market cap before discussions ceased.
fields.summary_ko.2: SK Hynix trades below 7x PER, appearing undervalued, but faces investment risk from the historical cyclicality of the DRAM, NAND flash, and HBM memory markets.
